neighbours.label: ' the' opening the defining noun phrase after a copula in a definition ('X is the plane perpendicular to…')
fire: In geometry, a chord is the segment joining two points on a circle.
The kernel of a linear map is the set of vectors sent to zero.
Velocity is defined as the rate of change of position with time.
A gene's locus is the position it occupies on a chromosome.
The equator is the line of latitude halfway between the poles.
Entropy can be described as the measure of disorder in a system.
The union of two sets is the set of elements in either one.
A watershed is the area of land that drains into a single river.
quiet: In geometry class, we drew a chord across the circle with a ruler.
We computed the kernel of the linear map on the blackboard.
The car's velocity changed quickly when the driver braked.
Scientists mapped the gene to a region near the chromosome tip.
Ships crossing the equator once held a ceremony for new sailors.
Entropy increased when the ice melted in the warm room.
We drew the union of two sets with overlapping circles.
Heavy rain flooded the watershed and closed the river roads.

notes: Card: ' the' x29 of top 32, after 'is', 'are', 'be', 'as' in definitions (the equatorial plane is the plane…, believed to be the sister group…). Output promotes intersection/set/subset. Probe: 'A prime number is the number…' 0.54, 'She is the director' 0.16, plain 'the' near zero. Near misses keep 'the' in the same scientific sentences but not as a predicate of a definition.
